fullBiography.title: Who Is Debisa Daricha Daba?
paragraphs: Debisa Daricha Daba is an Ethiopian Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer passionate about building practical, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions. His work focuses primarily on modern web application development, combining strong software engineering principles with technologies such as JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.

Debisa developed his foundation in Software Engineering through his academic studies at Dambi Dollo University, where he gained experience in software development, system analysis and design, databases, web technologies, and software engineering methodologies.

One of his major projects is a Web-Based Job Portal System, designed to connect job seekers, employers, and administrators through a centralized recruitment platform. The system includes authentication, role-based access control, job posting and management, job applications, CV handling, online examinations, and application management. Through this project, Debisa gained practical experience in developing full-stack applications and integrating frontend, backend, database, and authentication technologies.

Beyond academic projects, Debisa is interested in developing solutions that address real-world problems in areas such as employment, agriculture, business management, and digital services. He continuously works to improve his programming, system-building, problem-solving, communication, and professional skills.

As a growing software professional, Debisa's goal is to become an accomplished Full-Stack Software Engineer and System Builder, contributing to innovative technology projects while creating reliable and meaningful digital products that can positively impact individuals, organizations, and communities.

projects.title: Web-Based Job Portal System
projects.description: Comprehensive recruitment platform connecting job seekers, employers, and administrators with online examinations, CV handling, and role-based access control.
projects.longDescription: The Web-Based Job Portal System is Debisa's major academic project at Dambi Dollo University, engineered to connect job seekers and employers through a centralized recruitment platform. Features dual portals for Candidates & Employers, multi-role authentication (Applicant, Recruiter, Admin), role-based access control, job posting & application management, CV handling, online examinations, and live application status tracking built on the MERN stack.

projects.title: Odoo ERP Enterprise Solution
projects.description: Customized Odoo ERP enterprise system integrating sales, inventory control, accounting, CRM, and human resource management modules.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end Odoo ERP solution engineered for organizational operational efficiency. Configured custom Python modules, automated workflow triggers, dynamic business intelligence reporting, and REST API data synchronization.

projects.title: AgriLink Ethiopia
projects.description: Digital agricultural commodity marketplace and live market price intelligence platform empowering farmers across Ethiopia.
projects.longDescription: AgriLink Ethiopia bridges the gap between Ethiopian agricultural producers and regional crop buyers. Features real-time commodity price tracking (Teff, Maize, Coffee, Sesame), direct buyer-seller trading channels, and logistics tracking.
